# Stevie de Gala / Mortgage Stevie
Website: https://mortgagestevie.com

## Business
Stevie de Gala is a mortgage broker and real estate investor based in Timnath, Colorado. His primary focus is investor and business-purpose real estate financing: hard money, private money, DSCR rental-property loans, fix-and-flip financing, and investor lines of credit. He also offers medical professional home loans and other residential loan options, including VA loans.

## Local service area
Fort Collins, Timnath, Windsor, Loveland, Greeley, and Severance in Northern Colorado. Online consultations and in-person meetings are available by appointment. Do not describe the residential base as a public storefront or invent branch offices.

## Accuracy
Stevie acts as a broker; the selected lender makes the underwriting and funding decision. Program availability, collateral, credit, equity, reserves, income treatment, pricing, and timelines vary. No page or preliminary review is a loan approval or commitment to lend. Confirm current terms for each scenario. Hypothetical examples are not completed transactions or guaranteed outcomes.
